Privacy

Last updated: 4 October 2026

healthycooks is an independent, student-built project run from Singapore. It is not affiliated with or endorsed by HPB or any government agency. This page explains, in plain language, what the site does with information.

The short version

You don't need an account, and the site doesn't ask for your name, email or any other personal details. We don't use advertising or analytics trackers, and we don't receive or keep any information about you from the site itself.

What is saved in your browser

To make the site more useful, it saves a few small items in your own browser using local storage. This stays on your device and is never sent to us:

  • Cooking progress for each recipe: the step you reached, the number of portions, and ingredients you ticked.
  • Favourites: the recipes you saved with the heart button.
  • Theme: whether you chose dark mode.

The site itself does not set cookies. You can remove these items at any time by clearing the site's data in your browser settings, or with the "Start this recipe over" button for a single recipe. Clearing your browser data also removes your favourites.

Videos

Technique videos are YouTube videos. They only load after you press Play video, and we use YouTube's privacy-enhanced mode. Once a video loads, YouTube (Google) may receive information such as your IP address and may store cookies or similar data on your device, under Google's privacy policy. If you'd rather avoid this, don't press Play, or use the "Watch on YouTube" link and manage your preferences there.

Hosting

The site is hosted by Vercel. Like most web hosts, it may automatically log technical information such as your IP address, browser type and the pages requested, for security and reliability. We don't use these logs to identify you. See Vercel's privacy policy for details.

Links to other sites

Recipes and credits link to other websites, such as retailers, video creators and food-safety agencies. We aren't responsible for how those sites handle your information, so please check their policies.

Prices, nutrition and safety

Prices, nutrition numbers and cooking times are estimates for general information only, not professional dietary, medical or food-safety advice. If you have allergies, a health condition or dietary needs, check labels and speak to a qualified professional.

Children

The site is for a general audience and does not collect personal information from anyone, including children.

If this changes

If we later add accounts, a feedback form, email sign-up or analytics, we will update this page first, say what we collect and why, and ask for your consent where required, in line with Singapore's Personal Data Protection Act.

Contact

Questions or concerns? Email itscadmus@gmail.com.
